name: Nerona USD
oneLiner: USDnr is Nerona's permissioned 1:1 wrapper of M0's M token backed by short-term U.S. T-bills; T-bill yield accrues to M0 and Nerona, not USDnr holders.
collateral: Backed 1:1 by $M (M0 Protocol's tokenized short-term U.S. Treasury bill exposure, sourced from the M0 Minter MXON). USDnr is a permissioned wrapper minted by Nerona Labs against $M held in M0-managed reserves, with a Stability Reserve buffer maintained on top of circulating supply
pegMechanism: Permissioned 1:1 wrapper around M0's $M token: USDnr is minted by Nerona Labs by depositing/wrapping $M (sourced from MXON, the legal Minter on the M0 network) and burned 1:1 against $M on redemption. T-bill yield earned by the underlying $M accrues to the M0 reserve and Nerona — USDnr holders receive no rebase or NAV growth. The yield-bearing variant sUSDnr (Upshift ERC-4626 vault) routes that yield to stakers. Mint/redeem is gated to permissioned, KYC-onboarded clients of Nerona's private wealth platform

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534825 and Fluent block 10309817, the EIP-1967 implementation slots resolve to the independently verified JMIExtension implementations 0x1028a0e146d2915c509c8e019e0e5c66d3d22ae0 and 0x18091d82d55f68205f7f829acadb7897a7cb7d9c. Both verified implementations expose FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE, freeze(address), freezeAccounts(address[]), unfreeze, unfreezeAccounts, and pause controls. Role-event histories show FREEZE_MANAGER_ROLE was transferred from the deployment account to 0x169A3703D64a100897C0E208a3Dcad86F3F6eC29; pinned hasRole reads for that account return true on both deployments. Therefore an active privileged authority can directly freeze arbitrary holder accounts across every tracked USDnr deployment.

mintAuthority.summary: USDnr is an M0-backed extension; extension wrapping routes through M0 extension infrastructure where deployed while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing USDnr depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply.
routeChecks.caps: SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Ethereum SwapFacility is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy controlled by ProxyAdmin -> TimelockController with a 3-day delay; Fluent has no known M0 SwapFacility deployment in this review.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: EIP-1967 impl slot=0x45bf08d042a8958f01f8e8319b791e4584550da8 (TransparentUpgradeableProxy). ProxyAdmin=0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924; ProxyAdmin owner=TimelockController 0x23ca665c8a73292fc7ac2cc4493d2ce883bba468 (3-day minDelay). Fluent deployment: no M0 official deployment address found for Fluent; Fluent chain not covered by this control.

controls.label: USDnr token ProxyAdmin
controls.capDescription: Controls the EIP-1967 admin slot of the USDnr token proxy itself; can replace the JMIExtension implementation that defines USDnr's wrap/unwrap and freeze logic.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25579998: USDnr proxy 0xd48e565561416de59da1050ed70b8d75e8ef28f9 EIP-1967 admin slot resolves to this ProxyAdmin contract, matching the impl-slot read (0x1028a0e146d2915c509c8e019e0e5c66d3d22ae0) already reviewed under blacklistabilityReview.

controls.label: USDnr ProxyAdmin owner (EOA)
controls.capDescription: Sole owner of the USDnr token's ProxyAdmin; can push a new implementation with no on-chain timelock, module, or multisig — a single compromised key could rewrite USDnr's mint, wrap, or freeze logic.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25579998, owner() on ProxyAdmin 0x9ffe615c92635e5b36de004dd78a94c51aa04256 returns 0xc07F0b4556E0cc1bFd8A076a98d43E79ACD3Cd33; eth_getCode for that address returns 0x, confirming an externally-owned account with no multisig or timelock wrapper.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: MinterGateway confirmed immutable (IsProxy=false, EIP-1967 slots zero). SwapFacility confirmed TransparentUpgradeableProxy; ProxyAdmin=0x0f38d8a5... → TimelockController 0x23ca665c... (3-day minDelay); proposer is Gnosis Safe 3/5. Fluent chain has no known M0 SwapFacility deployment; Ethereum controls cover base M issuance. Same governance as verified musd-metamask. Upgrade-authority follow-up (2026-07-21): the USDnr token's own EIP-1967 proxy (0xd48e565561416de59da1050ed70b8d75e8ef28f9) resolves to ProxyAdmin 0x9ffe615c92635e5b36de004dd78a94c51aa04256, whose owner() is a single externally-owned account (0xc07F0b4556E0cc1bFd8A076a98d43E79ACD3Cd33, empty bytecode) with no timelock or multisig — unlike the SwapFacility's 3-day TimelockController, the USDnr wrapper's own implementation can be replaced immediately by one key.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDNR is an M0-extension stablecoin; its Ethereum and Fluent deployments are transparent proxies administered by Nerona's own ProxyAdmin (identical admin on both chains, read 2026-07-20). No third-party bridge carries the representation.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-2 (lead usdc-circle)

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: USDNR is an M0 extension on Ethereum backed by the M0 MinterGateway rail (mint-authority review 2026-06-11); the token proxy's EIP-1967 admin is Nerona's ProxyAdmin 0x9ffe615c92635e5b36de004dd78a94c51aa04256 (owner EOA 0xc07f0b4556e0cc1bfd8a076a98d43e79acd3cd33, read 2026-07-20).

Issuer-native deployment: the Fluent USDNR token is the same-style transparent proxy with the identical EIP-1967 admin 0x9ffe615c92635e5b36de004dd78a94c51aa04256 (owner EOA 0xc07f0b4556e0cc1bfd8a076a98d43e79acd3cd33) as the canonical Ethereum deployment (read 2026-07-20) — Nerona/M0 administers the deployment directly; no third-party bridge contract sits in the mint path. The Fluent Foundation's BLEND token-sale disclosure (April 2026) confirms USDnr is an M0-platform extension legally issued by MXON as Minter, with Fluent as an official M0 spoke chain.
